underdog.heading: Why Oregon State can keep it close
bullets: Oregon State is the better football team by 2.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-2.4 pts).

It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
